shortDescription: The Product Review section provides a complete review system for displaying and collecting customer feedback. It pulls reviews from a configured data source and presents them with a rating summary in various sizes and orientations. Users can filter and sort reviews, and submit new ones through a customizable dialog. The review dialog supports optional login requirements, product info display, short summaries, and success messages. Login and success dialogs are configurable as sidebar blocks.
